title: Ship opum-ward from a lean plugin root carrying only plugin.json and skills/ (DEC-246 a4, 0.1.1)
description:
Filed from WCLI-82 by the ward-cli worker on 2026-10-26, on DEC-246 (a4) relayed by team-lead: the #887 pin merges now, and the lean plugin root is ward-cli's for 0.1.1.

DEC-246 (a4): the opum-ward plugin should ship from a directory that carries only .claude-plugin/plugin.json and skills/, so that installing it fetches nothing. Today the plugin is the repository root: its marketplace entry points at this tree, so an install runs a dependency install that pulls dev tools and a native addon (the keychain binding) along with it. None of that is needed to run the skill, and the skill is all a plugin consumer is asking for.

Scope, as ruled:
- A plugin directory carrying only .claude-plugin/plugin.json and skills/ (skills/ward/SKILL.md today), so a plugin install fetches nothing beyond the skill and its manifest.
- The manifests that name the plugin, its version and its skill path follow it: package.json and .claude-plugin/plugin.json still agree on 0.1.1, and test/plugin-manifest.test.ts is what holds that.
- opum-fleet repoints its marketplace entry at that cut once it exists. That repoint is opum-fleet's change, not this repository's; this task ends when the directory and its manifest exist and the tests pass here.

Not in scope: any change to .github/workflows/release.yml between 0.1.0 and the next cut (see WCLI-91 criterion 2), and any change to the CLI's own behaviour.

Nothing is to be changed for this until 0.1.1 is scheduled: this task records the ruling and its scope so the work is not re-derived. It rides the same cut as WCLI-91 and the two are independent changes.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The plugin ships from a directory that carries only .claude-plugin/plugin.json and skills/, and nothing a plugin install would fetch beyond those.
package.json and the plugin manifest agree on the released version, held by test/plugin-manifest.test.ts.
Installing the pinned plugin in a fresh session resolves the skill from the lean directory, and the install pulls no dependency tree, dev tooling or native addon.

implementationNotes: DEC-246 (a7), opum-doc ruling 2026-10-28T14:01:48Z, relayed verbatim by team-lead: layout A, plugin/ at the repository root. ".claude-plugin/ and skills/ move under plugin/, and opum-fleet pins a git-subdir source of `plugin` at the 0.1.1 tag." Execution choices stand: the 0.1.1 bump stays in the cut, and the fresh-session-install criterion stays unticked until opum-fleet pins the tag.

Implementation: git mv of .claude-plugin/ and skills/ under plugin/; paths updated in src/adapters/skill-content.ts (the text import), scripts/check-evals.mjs (SKILLS_DIR), test/plugin-manifest.test.ts, README, spec, ADR 0011, ADR 0015, security-tests.md and the cutting runbook. New tests assert plugin/ holds exactly .claude-plugin/plugin.json and skills/, and that the old root locations are gone. CLAUDE.md also names skills/ward/SKILL.md in hand-written prose; left untouched as a governing file, for its owner to decide. Local gates: bun run check exit 0 (817 pass), lore check and lore validate --strict exit 0, check-lore-agent-sources 0 concepts in no profile. Criterion 3 is not claimed: it needs opum-fleet pinned at the 0.1.1 tag. The task stays In Progress for that reason.

Review round 1 (Opus, #204 at 2551573) fixed in one commit. (1) scripts/run-eval.sh ran `claude plugin eval .` from the root, which no longer holds the plugin. `claude plugin eval --eval-dir` is resolved BELOW the plugin root and refuses `..` ("--eval-dir must stay inside the plugin root"), so evals/ cannot stay at the root beside plugin/ and be reached from it; moving evals/ under plugin/ would break the lean root. The script now assembles a scratch tree (a byte copy of plugin/ plus evals/, minus results), evaluates that, and removes it on exit. Measured: a real run of one case (ward-no-trigger-password-meter, --runs 1, $0.23) against an assembled tree resolved plugin "opum-ward" 0.1.0 from that tree and scored 1.00 both arms; run-eval.sh itself was exercised with a stub claude that listed the tree it was handed (.claude-plugin/plugin.json, skills/ward/SKILL.md, the five eval cases, no results/). The full suite is first run at the cut. (2) docs/security-tests.md row restored to the dated 0.1.0 record; the cutting-runbook edit stays. (3) test/plugin-manifest.test.ts now walks plugin/ with lstat, rejects any symlink and asserts the sorted file list equals [.claude-plugin/plugin.json, skills/ward/SKILL.md]; a stray package.json and a symlink under plugin/skills each turn it red.
